jobs.description_text: About the team Security Business Enablement (SBE) is Stripe's commercial security function: the interface between Stripe's internal security program and its Go-to-Market organization. We make sure security and compliance requirements never block, delay, or devalue Stripe's deals. This work is about customer trust: businesses entrust Stripe with critical financial infrastructure, and their security teams need confidence that Stripe meets rigorous standards before, during, and after the sale. We make that trust tangible with accurate, consistent evidence of Stripe's security posture. We own security due diligence end to end: questionnaire response, compliance evidence, live security reviews, gap and exception management, contractual security exhibits, rapid response during industry-wide events, and executive briefings. We engage customers directly, up to CISO level, and equip sales teams to handle security conversations on their own. Our scope is unusually broad: one assessment can span security, privacy, business continuity, and resilience, translating deep control detail into language procurement, legal, and a CISO can each act on. We are often the first team asked to represent emerging parts of Stripe's posture. We work at the intersection of security, AI, and Go-to-Market. Our platform is built on authoritative grounding: answers are retrieved from a knowledge base we maintain and validate, not generated from first principles, so they are consistent and source-traceable. jobs.description_text: About the team Stripe’s Accounting Products team is building modern infrastructure for the Office of the CFO. Our vision is to give finance teams, and the agents that support them, one reconciled and explainable presentation of financial truth. Today, the data and context required to make accounting decisions are fragmented across billing systems, contracts, spreadsheets, general ledgers, and the minds of the people doing the work. Finance teams spend significant time reconstructing what happened, determining the appropriate accounting treatment, reconciling results, and gathering evidence. Giving an agent access to the underlying data is not enough: it also needs the business context, accounting policies, approved judgments, and guardrails required to act reliably. Revenue Recognition is our first major proof point. Stripe has a unique opportunity to help Billing and Metronome users turn complex revenue activity—including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, credits, and contract modifications—into accurate, explainable journal entries. Our ambition is for agents to take on the investigation, configuration, and repetitive work while accountants retain control over consequential judgments and approvals. Over time, we expect to expand into additional Office of the CFO workflows, and we are looking for a Staff Product Manager to help turn this vision into products that finance teams trust. As a Customer Success Associate you will be responsible for driving strategy for the Achievers recognition and engagement platform while continuously driving value for our customers. This role primarily supports program administrators (CSS function) while also contributing to Member Support to ensure seamless end-to-end service. You bring a strong understanding of the platform, apply advanced problem-solving skills, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive timely and effective resolutions. jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Customer Value & Growth Program Manager to own and drive the company-wide program that ensures our customers realize the value of their investment with Achievers and incrementally grow their spend with us as a result. Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Marketplace, Enablement, Revenue Operations and Finance each own a piece of this today. You will sit at the centre, pulling those pieces into one integrated strategy, guiding and collaborating with each team as they build their part, and making sure everything we do aligns to a consistent vision. You are accountable for making sure the right plans exist, that they connect, and that the functions who deliver them are set up to execute. Your impact comes from how well you align, equip and drive the people closest to our customers. The role goes beyond program management. We are looking for someone who brings a commercial point of view, challenges the plans on the table, contributes to the thinking, and acts as a genuine partner to every function involved.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, Marketplace ⭐
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical SFA/Manager to take full ownership of our global e-commerce Marketplace P&L, one of Achievers' most important revenue streams. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Intelligence, Customer Success, Merchandising, and Product, translating Marketplace activity into financial insight, strategic forecasting, and operational action. You won't just report the numbers - you'll explain what happened, forecast what comes next, and actively shape the strategy and direction to help support growth. From building predictive models and share-of-wallet analyses to partnering with Customer Success on NRR strategy and existing customer ARR forecasting, this is a role for someone who wants to make a measurable impact across the business. If you bring experience from e-commerce, retail, or a rewards/marketplace environment, that's a significant advantage, you'll hit the ground running with an intuitive understanding of redemption and e-commerce dynamics, catalogue economics, and customer purchasing behavior that are central to this role.

jobs.description_text: The Marketplace is the rewards shopping experience within the Achievers platform. Its performance is shaped by a connected set of drivers, including member access, traffic, utilization, conversion, redemption, catalogue relevance, vendor performance, fulfilment reliability and the economics of each transaction. As Manager, Marketplace Performance Intelligence, you will give Marketplace one clear view of performance and turn intelligence into coordinated action. You will lead Marketplace operational analytics and identify opportunities to improve performance and scalability, own the analytics roadmap and recurring performance routines, and shape executive narratives/decisions. You will work in close partnership with the Finance Manager, Marketplace through a formal dotted-line relationship, connecting FP&A’s official financial outlook and governance with deeper customer, member and operational evidence. This role is also expected to structure and execute complex analyses that are cross-functional, commercially material, ambiguous or executive-facing. Success requires strong analytical judgement, commercial curiosity and executive communication. You will work across Marketplace, FP&A, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Product Marketing, BI, Product Analytics, ProDev and Support to strengthen the analytical foundation, clarify ownership and translate findings into measurable action.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist, Computational Pathology
jobs.description_text: Build ML that changes how cancer is treated. Most medical AI stops with a publication. Our AI models guide treatment decisions today. Artera’s AI-driven prostate test is standard-of-care in the US and cancer patients in all 50 states are using our models to help make decisions about their therapy. While we started in prostate cancer, we’ve grown into a multi-cancer platform with more disease settings in development. You'll help build what's next. The role At Artera, we’re making ML development agent-first. You won’t spend your days hand-writing training loops, tuning hyperparameters in notebooks, or babysitting individual runs. Instead, you’ll design, direct, and evaluate autonomous research agents that propose hypotheses, write and execute experiments, and train models autonomously. You’ll be tasked with answering specific scientific questions: which patients can safely forgo aggressive treatment or inferring molecular traits from routine digital slides and your job will be to decide what’s worth investigating and which research directions merit investment.

jobs.description_text: About the Role Sourcing is where the money is actually decided. We are expanding our Data Capture Research team in Prague with a Senior Data Scientist to work on Sourcing. jobs.description_text: 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny 와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여함으로써, 효율적이고 지속 가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 13개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion에서 3D Design & Implementation Specialist를 채용합니다. [안내] 본 포지션은 패션 산업(브랜드, 벤더 등)에서 4-6년의 실무 경험을 갖춘 분들을 위한 채용입니다. CLO 소프트웨어의 기존 숙련도는 요구하지 않으며, 입사 후 새로운 IT 기술을 빠르게 습득하여 기존 패션 실무 지식과 결합할 수 있는 역량(Tech Savviness)을 중점적으로 평가합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [CLO Software Test] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] (1차 인터뷰 합격자에게는 2차 면접 전, CLO 사전 학습용 교육 자료 및 임시 라이선스가 제공됩니다. 2차 면접 시 진행되는 테스트는 기존의 CLO 숙련도가 아닌, 새로운 소프트웨어를 빠르게 습득하는 학습 능력과 패션 구조에 대한 이해도를 평가하기 위한 과정입니다.) To Apply 이력서 및 경력기술서 1부 (필수) 지원동기가 담긴 자기소개서 (필수) 본인의 담당 업무 및 참여 프로젝트가 기술된 포트폴리오 (선택) (CLO를 직접 다룬 경험이 없더라도, 참여하신 프로젝트 및 업무 경력을 확인하기 위해 포트폴리오 제출을 권장합니다.)

jobs.title: Accounting Associate
jobs.description_text: 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘에 대한 독보적인 기술력을 바탕으로, 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여하여 효율적이고 지속가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게끔 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 12개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. [CLO의 소프트웨어] CLO:https://www.clo3d.com Marvelous Designer:https://www.marvelousdesigner.com Jinny:https://connect.clo-set.com/jinny [CLO의 플랫폼] CLO-SET:https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus CONNECT:https://connect.clo-set.com/ [전세계 디자이너의 일하는 방식을 바꿔놓은 회사 - EO] https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RG8LFEKg1D8 [클로버추얼패션 채용 홈페이지] https://www.clovirtualfashion-careers.com/ Position Overview 클로버추얼패션의 Finance & Accounting Chapter는 회사의 숫자가 정확하고 투명하게 기록되도록 하고, 이를 바탕으로 회사가 올바른 의사결정을 내리고 지속적으로 성장할 수 있도록 돕습니다. 회사의 다음 성장 단계를 준비하는 여러 프로젝트를 진행함에 있어, 실무의 멤버로 참여하며 재무 전반의 경험을 함께하실 Accounting Associate를 선발합니다. 금번 포지션은 법인카드 및 일반비용 관리, 국내 매출 대사, 자금 반제 처리 등의 실무를 주도하며 데이터의 정합성을 높입니다. 특히, AI 네이티브 환경에 맞추어 단순 반복 업무와 서류 작업을 자동화하고 재무 워크플로우의 생산성을 극대화하는 과정을 함께할 분을 찾습니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격]

Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion의 글로벌 웹 기반 플랫폼과 서비스의 백엔드 개발에 참여할 동료를 모집합니다. 본 포지션은 CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠 관리 및 협업 플랫폼에 직접 참여하여, 고도화된 백엔드 서비스를 설계하고 구현하는 중요한 역할을 수행합니다. 플랫폼 서비스의 안정성과 확장성을 책임지는 백엔드 API 서버와 각종 Worker 서비스의 개발 및 구현을 담당하게 됩니다. 나아가 서비스 운영에 필수적인 검색 데이터 연동, 그리고 대용량 데이터 처리를 위한 다양한 백엔드 기술 통합을 경험하고 주도합니다. 최종적으로는 프론트엔드를 포함한 다양한 유관 부서와의 긴밀한 협업을 통해, 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 글로벌 플랫폼 서비스의 전반적인 기능을 설계하고 완성도 높은 제품을 만들어나갈 기회가 주어집니다. 기술 스택 (Tech Stack) Core: Kotlin/JAVA, Spring WebFlux/WebMVC, Coroutines Infra: Azure, AWS, K8s(optional), Docker AI Tools: Claude, Gemini Data: MS-SQL, Redis Monitoring: Datadog Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [과제 전형] → [1차 인터뷰] → [2차 인터뷰(+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] *이력서를 제출하실 때 본인의 업무 이력과 역할, 그리고 그 과정에서 어떠한 부분을 느끼고 성장했는지 적어 주시면 좋습니다. *2차 인터뷰 조율 과정에서 레퍼런스 체크 요청을 드리고 있습니다. *각 전형에 대한 상세 안내는 메일을 통해 안내해 드리고 있습니다.

jobs.description_text: CLO Virtual Fashion is redefining the future of apparel through cutting-edge 3D clothing simulation technology—powering the entire fashion lifecycle from concept and design to production, marketing, fitting, and styling. Since 2009, CLO has been building a dynamic digital fashion ecosystem, driven by its industry-leading simulation algorithms that blend the physical and virtual worlds of clothing. Our suite of tools—including CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny—streamlines every stage of the garment creation process, while platforms like CLO-SET and CONNECT enable seamless collaboration, content management, and digital asset workflows. Through smart tagging technology, CLO also links physical and digital garments, creating an integrated and intelligent fashion infrastructure built for the future of design and sustainability. CLO Virtual Fashion, a global leader in digital fashion innovation, operates across 16 offices in 13 countries—including key hubs in Asia, North America, Europe, and South America. As the demand for immersive, tech-driven fashion solutions grows, CLO continues to expand its global footprint, powered by a rapidly growing international user base and a future-focused vision. jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise - Expansion
jobs.description_text: Role We are looking for an Account Executive, Enterprise Germany to join our team. This is a remote role, reporting to the Regional Director in the Enterprise department. In this role, you will drive the strategic expansion of an existing enterprise account portfolio by identifying and winning new use cases across Zscaler's Zero Trust platform — from cloud-native security to AI workload protection. You engage C-level and senior stakeholders through highly professional, structured sales engagements, turning current customers into broad platform adopters and long-term strategic partners. Operating within a clearly defined, metrics-driven sales process, you translate Zscaler's transformational technology into measurable business outcomes to scale that impact systematically. What you'll do (Role Expectations) Own a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts (5000–40,000 employees), developing and executing multi-year account plans that drive platform adoption, revenue growth, and long-term strategic partnership across the full customer lifecycle Orchestrate tightly aligned, role-specific collaboration across Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, Transformation Architecture, Marketing, and BDRs — ensuring every customer interaction reflects a coherent, high-quality One-Team engagement throughout the entire sales cycle Drive disciplined, creative pipeline development on a weekly cadence — proactively identifying new use case opportunities within existing account
